collectorNotes:
Google 自己的材料（模型卡、方法说明 PDF、博客表格图、Google Cloud 开发者指南）给出的可用列为 TB4 19.1、DeepSWE v1.1 73.7、GDPVal-AA v2 Elo 1545、GDP.PDF 35.0、OSWorld-2.0 partial 59.0、HLE-Verified 54.9（不可比），开发者指南另列 HLE 45.4%（设置不明）。博客表格图与模型卡内容一致。

线索中的 OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 发布页（openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/）对 curl 和 WebFetch 都返回 403，archive 和 reader 代理也不可用；它的 system card（deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-6-astra）全文不含 Gemini。所以线索里 OpenAI 打印的 TB4 19.1、DeepSWE 73.8、FrontierCode 1.1 Main 43.6 / Extended 56.3 都未能在原页核实，没有记录。FrontierCode 因此列入 not_found：43.6 只见于二手转述，需要能打开 OpenAI 页面后补录。

各榜单核查结果：
- Zapier AutomationBench 页面只显示前 10 名（'See 116 more' 需前端加载），脚注提到 Gemini 3.8 Flash 有 Medium/High 两个条目，但读不到分数。
- OSWorld 2 官方 JSON、Agents' Last Exam API、Toolathlon 文档榜、CritPt、SciCode 官方榜都没有此模型。
- TB-Science 官方 Harbor 榜是客户端渲染，读不到，只记录了 Vals 的独立运行结果。

主值选择有两处例外：GDPval-AA 用 Anthropic 引用的 AA v2.1 Elo 1435，没有用 Google 自报的 v2 1545；HLE 用 Scale 完整集 44.52，没有用 Google 设置不明的 45.4。两处都是因为口径与首选设置一致。博客中的 CWE-Bench 47.2 属于 Flash Cyber 变体，已排除。
verifierSummary: I opened all 15 records at their URLs. Every number appears for Gemini 3.8 Flash itself, and all comparability flags follow the column rules, so all 15 are confirmed with no corrections. How I checked: the Google model card's first column is Gemini 3.8 Flash. Its methods PDF (storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/gemini/gemini_3-8_flash_model_evaluation.pdf) confirms four settings: the TB4 number comes from the official board at the highest-scoring thinking level; DeepSWE was self-run with mini-swe-agent at high; GDPVal-AA v2 comes from Artificial Analysis's board; OSWorld 2.0 is the partial score, best of 3 runs, batched tool calls, run before the 08.08 patch. Other sources: the tbench.ai data has accuracy 19.09 with n_trials 330 (mini-SWE-agent, high). Vals TB4 is 19.19% (avg@3, three refusals by this model scored as failures). Vals TB-Science is 8.57% (single run pass@1, all 70 tasks of v0.1.0). The DeepSWE v1.1 board shows "74 % ± 1 %" (updated September 22, 2026); its underlying data gives pass_at_1 = 0.7383. FrontierSWE V2 lists mean reward 0.1963 over 170 runs; on the main table Google is represented only by Gemini 4 Argon. Scale HLE gives 44.52 for the full set and 44.95 for text-only; the boards announce HLE-Rolling but still use the original HLE. The Google Cloud guide shows 45.4%. Page 131 of the Haiku 5.5 card, in section 8.10.2 'GDPval-AA v2.1', gives Elo 1435, run by Artificial Analysis.
